data.name: Rohini
data.gender_notes: Rohini is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit rohiṇī, 'a red cow', also the star Aldebaran. Its root is Sanskrit rohiṇī (रोहिणी). A nakshatra; the mother of Balarama. Rohini is a Sanskrit name meaning “A star (Aldebaran); a red cow”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rohini expresses “A star (Aldebaran); a red cow”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit rohiṇī, 'a red cow', also the star Aldebaran.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rohini total 46, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
